subject: journey/nautilus
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single landscape 3:2 illustration for the historical atlas sketchbook of Jules Verne's Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea. A nineteenth-century naturalist's field sketch in graphite and sepia pen with restrained transparent watercolour washes on warm ivory paper. Fine irregular parallel hatching, economical contour lines, a few details sharply observed; leave areas of cream paper around irregular unfinished edges. One coherent scene that reads at small sizes. No captions, labels, border, binding, signatures, photorealism, modern equipment, or Disney submarine designs. On the shore of a tropical island in Torres Strait, Ned Land in simple 1860s seagoing clothes roasts thick slices of breadfruit on small glowing embers, rough green round breadfruit and broad lobed leaves nearby, laden skiff on sand, low reef beyond. Hands tending food are the focus.
